verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents service keys specifically for AI agent/MCP use that are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped to specific tasks, plus OAuth-based MCP connection that requires explicit review/approval of what the assistant is requesting and workspace selection. This directly supports scoped, least-privilege credentialing for agents. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of scope granularity, no explicit documentation of the exact permission list available to service keys, and no third-party corroboration.
